d.s: The indefinite continued progress of existence and events.

e.s: I do not have enough time today.
What time is the meeting?
Time flies when you are having fun.

d.s: A human being regarded as an individual.

e.s: She is a kind person.
Only one person was in the room.
e.t: V místnosti byla jen jedna osoba.

e.s: Each person must show an ID.
e.t: Každá osoba musí předložit průkaz totožnosti.

d.s: A period of 365 or 366 days.

e.s: We moved here last year.
e.t: Přestěhovali jsme se sem minulý rok.

e.s: The project will finish next year.
It takes a year to train for this.
e.t: Příprava na to trvá jeden rok.

d.s: A method, style, or manner of doing something.
d.t: Metoda, styl nebo cesta, jak něco udělat.

e.s: There is a better way to solve this.
e.t: Existuje lepší způsob, jak to vyřešit.

e.s: Can you show me the way to the station?
e.t: Můžete mi ukázat cestu na nádraží?

e.s: She did it in her own way.

d.s: A period of twenty-four hours.

e.s: It was a sunny day yesterday.
I drink coffee every day.
Have a nice day at work.

d.s: An object, item, or entity.

e.s: What is that thing on the table?
e.t: Co je ta věc na stole?

e.s: The best thing to do is wait.
I have one more thing to say.
e.t: Mám ještě jednu věc na srdci.

d.s: An adult male human being.

e.s: A tall man opened the door.
He is a wise man with great experience.
e.t: Je to moudrý muž s velkými zkušenostmi.

e.s: The man smiled at the children.

d.s: The earth, together with all of its countries and peoples.
d.t: Země se všemi svými státy a lidmi.

e.s: She traveled around the world.
We want to make the world a better place.
News travels fast in our modern world.
e.t: V našem moderním světě se zprávy šíří rychle.

d.s: The condition that distinguishes animals and plants from inorganic matter.
d.t: Stav, který odlišuje živé organismy od anorganické hmoty.

e.s: She lived a long and happy life.
Water is essential for life.
This discovery changed his life completely.
e.t: Tento objev zcela změnil jeho život.

d.s: The end part of a person's arm beyond the wrist.
d.t: Koncová část lidské paže od zápěstí.

e.s: He raised his hand to ask a question.
She held my hand tightly.
Wash your hands before eating.

d.s: A position on a scale of intensity or amount, or a stage in a process.

e.s: The water level in the river is rising.
He has reached a high level of skill.
The game has multiple difficulty levels.

d.s: come to have, obtain, or receive

e.s: I need to get some sleep.
She got a new job.
Can you get me a glass of water?

d.s: Needing or using a lot of effort or skill.

e.s: This is a difficult problem to solve.
e.t: Toto je obtížný problém k vyřešení.

e.s: He found the exam very difficult.
It was a difficult decision to make.

d.s: used to indicate similarity or resemblance

e.s: He looks like his father.
She sings like an angel.
It feels like rain.

d.s: Because; as.

e.s: I'm going home now cuz I'm tired.
e.t: Jdu teď domů, protože jsem unavený.

e.s: He failed the test cuz he didn't study.
e.t: Neprošel u testu, protože se neučil.

e.s: We can't go out cuz it's raining.

d.s: A man or boy.

e.s: He's a really nice guy.
Who is that guy over there?
The guy I met yesterday was friendly.
e.t: Chlápek, kterého jsem včera potkal, byl přátelský.

d.s: To a high degree; extremely.

e.s: This is a very important point.
She was very happy to see him.
e.t: Byla velmi šťastná, že ho viděla.

e.s: The weather is very cold today.

d.s: A piece of protective clothing or covering worn to defend the body, especially in combat.
d.t: Obrnění, zbroj, pancíř (kus ochranného oděvu nebo krytu nošený k ochraně těla, zejména v boji).

e.s: The knight wore heavy armor into battle.
e.t: Rytíř si do bitvy oblékl těžkou zbroj.

e.s: The tank's armor was thick enough to withstand the attack.
e.t: Pancíř tanku byl dostatečně silný, aby odolal útoku.

e.s: Body armor is essential for soldiers in combat zones.
e.t: Neprůstřelná vesta je nezbytná pro vojáky v bojových zónách.

d.s: A contest or game between two people or teams.
d.t: Zápas nebo hra mezi dvěma lidmi nebo týmy.

e.s: The football matchup between the rivals was intense.
e.t: Fotbalový zápas mezi rivaly byl napínavý.

e.s: This chess matchup is expected to be very close.
e.t: Očekává se, že tento šachový zápas bude velmi těsný.

e.s: We're analyzing the strengths and weaknesses of each team before the matchup.
e.t: Před zápasem analyzujeme silné a slabé stránky každého týmu.

d.s: a cause, motive, or justification for an action or event.

e.s: What is the reason for your absence?
He gave a good reason for being late.
e.t: Uvedl dobrý důvod svého pozdního příchodu.

e.s: There must be a reason for this behavior.

d.s: The cardinal number corresponding to the lowest positive integer; a single item or person.
d.t: Číslovka označující nejmenší kladné celé číslo; jedna věc nebo osoba.

e.s: He scored one goal in the first half.
e.t: V prvním poločase vstřelil jeden gól.

e.s: There is only one way to solve this problem.
e.t: Existuje pouze jeden způsob, jak tento problém vyřešit.

e.s: She is the one I was looking for.
e.t: Ona je ta, kterou jsem hledal.

d.s: Used to refer to a person or thing that is present in the immediate vicinity or that has just been mentioned.
d.t: Tento, tato, toto (ukazuje na osobu nebo věc v bezprostřední blízkosti nebo právě zmíněnou).

e.s: This book is very interesting.
What is this noise?
I like this song.
